cases.title: Payment API timeouts after deployment
cases.description: Payment requests time out after the latest production release. The application reports that it cannot acquire database connections, while database connection usage is at its configured limit.

cases.title: Checkout API timeout during traffic surge
cases.description: Checkout requests time out during a traffic surge. The Kubernetes deployment stays at its original pod count even though CPU utilization is high and the autoscaler should have added replicas.
cases.expected_passage_contains: Horizontal Pod Autoscaler failed to scale

cases.title: Authentication failures
cases.description: Users cannot authenticate. The authentication service logs show cache connection errors and the Redis cluster health check is failing.

cases.title: High memory usage after deployment
cases.description: A microservice's memory usage grows continuously after the latest deployment until the process is restarted by the container runtime.
